question: Should this maintainer replacement PR become the canonical implementation and establish the typed `phone-number` Plugin SDK login method, or should the proof-positive contributor PR at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/85866 be preferred?
rationale: Both branches are viable and mergeable, but they differ in proof status and implementation history; selecting the permanent public plugin contract and canonical contribution path requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Adopt this replacement after live proof
options.body: Use the more focused current implementation and require exact-head phone-code and QR pairing evidence before merge, then close the older PR as superseded.

options.title: Prefer the proof-positive contributor PR
options.body: Continue with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/85866 if maintainers prefer its demonstrated physical-device flow, repairing base drift as needed and closing this replacement.

recommendation.title: Adopt this replacement after live proof
recommendation.body: Use the more focused current implementation and require exact-head phone-code and QR pairing evidence before merge, then close the older PR as superseded.
